replies.author: Claude
replies.text: Found the cause: after 'not the rest' your eyes go to the screen about 0.1 s after the last word, and the cut kept 4 frames of it; the next line then starts while you're still looking down. Fixing it across the whole video, not just here: a local face tracker (runs on this PC) reads where your eyes point on every frame around every cut, and each line now ends on the last frame before the glance and starts on the first frame you're back on the lens. It never cuts a word: if you glance while still talking, the word stays. Mid-sentence glances (reading a name) are left alone.

replies.author: Claude
replies.text: v4b: the frames after each line are trimmed at 107 cuts. Close-ups showed you usually start glancing during the last syllable, so to keep the word the last few frames of the glance stay. v4c fixes those with split edits: the picture cuts to your next line up to 0.2 s before the sound ends (57 cuts). With graphics on screen, only about 24 of these glances are visible at all; the rest sit under full-screen graphics.
